questions.text: Which protocol suite designed by IETF to provide security for a packet at the Internet layer?
questions.solution:
IPSec is the IETF protocol suite that secures packets at the IP (Internet) layer. SSL/TLS works above TCP.

Answer: IPSec

Match with the suitable one:
[latex]\begin{array}{|l|l|l|l|} \hline & \text { List-1 } & & \text { List-2 } \\ \hline \text { (a) } & \text { Multicast group membership } & \text { i. } & \text { Distance Vector routing } \\ \hline \text { (b) } & \text { Interior gateway protocol } & ii . & \text { IGMP } \\ \hline \text { (c) } & \text { Exterior gateway protocol } & iii . & \text { OSPF } \\ \hline \text { (d) } & \text { RIP } & iv . & \text { BGP } \\ \hline \end{array}[/latex]
questions.solution:
Checking each statement:
- Multicast group membership [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] IGMP (ii)
- Interior gateway protocol [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] OSPF (iii)
- Exterior gateway protocol [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] BGP (iv)
- RIP [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] distance vector routing (i)

Answer: a-ii, b-iii, c-iv, d-i
